summary: Regression + circular-structure bug-fix verification for Copper Strip Analyzer. Backend 13/13 pytest cases pass (root, ASTM reference of 12 ratings, analyze happy-path + invalid data URL, list filters/date/search/include_image, GET by id, PATCH, PDF, CSV, DELETE+404). Frontend manual flow verified end-to-end via Playwright: real copper-toned JPEG uploaded via file-input, sample-name and notes filled, analyze-btn clicked -> POST /api/analyze returned rating 1B / Slight Tarnish, result-card rendered with rating/category/description, record appeared in /history table, view-btn opened detail, delete-btn removed row. Critically, NO 'Converting circular structure to JSON' error appeared and no page-level errors were captured -- the onClick={()=>analyze()} + string-guard fix works. IP webcam clean-error path also verified: with baseUrl set to http://127.0.0.1:9999 and streamOk forced true, capture-btn click produced a clean 'Could not load snapshot' toast, not a circular-structure crash. Accuracy prompt confirmed: 'COLOR-ACCURACY PROTOCOL' present in server.py and ASTM_REFERENCE_IMAGE_B64 loads from /app/backend/assets/astm_reference_chart_llm.jpg (231KB).
critical_code_review_comments: AnalyzerPage.jsx analyze(): the string-guard `typeof overrideDataUrl === 'string'` is a good defensive fix. Consider extracting the DOM-event-vs-argument pattern into a small utility if the same pattern is repeated.

IpWebcamCard.jsx: captureFromCamera falls through to imageToDataUrl on any fetch failure, which will taint the canvas if CORS not enabled -- the resulting 'Canvas tainted' error is surfaced as a toast, which is correct. No change needed.
server.py still has logging.basicConfig / logger defined above analyze_with_ai (fixed in prior iteration). All good.
Consider adding `data-testid` on the sonner toast so tests can positively assert error/success toast text rather than sniffing page body.
seed_data_creation: Playwright test uploaded 'TEST_UI_Regression' sample; deletion attempted at the end. Pytest test_analyze_success creates a TEST_ record and deletes it in test_delete_and_404. No stale test data left.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Bug fix for circular-structure JSON error confirmed resolved. File input has data-testid='file-input' but is class='hidden' -- Playwright must use state='attached' (not visible) when waiting or setting files. IP webcam capture button is disabled when streamOk===false; to enable in a headless test, dispatch 'load' event on ipcam-stream-img via page.evaluate. Success toasts use sonner (no data-testid); assert via body text if needed.
rca of the issue: Original circular-structure error root-caused to onClick={analyze} passing React SyntheticEvent as first arg (interpreted as overrideDataUrl). axios then tried to JSON.stringify a request body containing the DOM event/FiberNode -> circular ref. Fix (already applied) is two-fold: (1) button uses onClick={()=>analyze()} so no arg is passed; (2) analyze() guards with `typeof overrideDataUrl === 'string'` so a stray event would be ignored. Regression test: manual upload + analyze click confirmed no crash and successful 200 with rendered result card.
